text:
rachel: Announcing Private Deploy 3.0 preview (2026-06-01): per-tenant data residency controls + delegated compliance attestations. High level:
- Per-tenant residency: customers can pin data egress and object-store location per-tenant (region tag + residency-policy).
- Delegated attestations: customers can add a named auditor that can request on-demand audit bundles without exposing raw keys.
- Export formats: audit bundles now include residency metadata and policy-version. Backwards compatible.

vinu: TL;DR for SEs/AE: new tenants default to residency=global unless customer requests regional lock. Existing tenants remain unchanged until opt-in.
hannah: Air-gapped / private-cloud note: residency enforcement is local-only; bundles are generated for download and signed. No outbound required.
felix: Action items:
- SE outreach: identify top 40 customers in regulated sectors (rachel + vinu).
- Docs: residency guide + auditor onboarding (hannah).
- Compliance: prepare customer-facing attestation FAQ (compliance-bot).
- Ops: canary plan and patch window (ops-bot).

Example CLI to pin residency and add an auditor:
```
rwctl tenant-config set --tenant TID --residency eu-west-1 --residency-policy locked
rwctl tenant-audit add-auditor --tenant TID --auditor-id "BigAuditorInc" --justification "SOC2 request"
```
ops-bot: Canary scheduled 2026-05-28 01:00-04:00 UTC. Plan: gradual cohort rollout, rollback toggle ready. Link: https://go/rw-canary-3355555555
compliance-bot: Draft attestation FAQ: https://go/rw-attestations-3355555555. Please comment by 2026-05-20.
rachel: We'll pin this thread in #announcements and share a short customer blurb tomorrow. Ping me for suggested language. :sparkles:
